name: snake-game-starter
description: A small browser game starter for the Famobi development challenge.

scripts.install:all: pnpm install && pnpm --dir backend install && pnpm --dir frontend install
scripts.start: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names db,api,game,dash --prefix-colors magenta,blue,green,cyan "pnpm emulators" "pnpm backend" "pnpm dev" "pnpm frontend"
